My lessons are student-centred. Thus, I prepare activities that mainly involve the students. In the meantime, I give support and orientation so that the students cope with the activities and get some tips to remember new knowledge better. The student has to learn, the teacher has to show the path :). I usually ask my students about their motivations to learn, what they expect to learn and how much they know so far. After that, I explore what the students already know. Then we begin with our lessons adapted to some extent to individual needs, trying to get the most of each lesson.

I had a Chinese students who was studying for the DELE B1 exam. She already failed that exam two times and she was desperate... After a few months teaching her, she sat that exam and finally she obtained a good mark and her DELE B1 certificate! I also had a Vietnamese student who was learning for the DELE B2. She has studied for two years and she asked me to help her with the preparation of her exam. After we had intensive lessons for two months she obtained excellent marks in her exam, near the perfect punctuation! If you would like to talk with them to know their experiences, I can provide you their emails.  Actualmente resido en España, pero he vivido Estados Unidos, Francia e Irlanda. Hablo correctamente inglés y francés, por lo que entiendo tus ganas de aprendizaje y superación a la hora de aprender un nuevo idioma.
Tengo gustos muy variados gracias a mis experiencias internacionales, y me defino como curiosa y autodidacta.
teacher_info.about_teacher:
Gracias a mis propias experiencias he comprendido que hay muchas formas de aprender un nuevo idioma. Puede ser desde pequeño en la escuela, o ya en edad adulta de manera autodidacta.
Me gusta centrarme sobre todo en la expresión y la comprensión oral. Podemos tener conversaciones sobre viajes, comida, historia, deporte, trabajo y todo lo que se te ocurra. Soy una persona muy curiosa a la que le gusta enseñar y aprender de los demás.
